text: The subject Iqra Yousaf holds account PK**HABB****7071 which was opened on 18 November 2020. The customer is a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month. During the activity window from 3 May 2026 to 28 May 2026 the account recorded 11 credits totalling PKR 16,964,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 13,902,000. The activity comprised 10 cash deposits totalling PKR 16,814,000 made across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). The activity was flagged by Tazama on 28 May 2026, with the Tazama typology STR-PK-01 scoring 320 against an alert threshold of 300. Repeated cash deposits were observed, with 9 of 10 cash deposits (90%) between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, i.e., just below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, consistent with the structuring hypothesis. The total credits were 113.1 times the declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month, indicating cash volume inconsistent with the declared income, as noted in the structuring hypothesis. Overall, the pattern of near‑threshold cash deposits across several branches, disproportionate to a declared income of PKR 150,000 per month and the reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, is consistent with suspected structuring. PKR 13,902,000 was transferred to Al-Noor Exchange Company (PK**AL-N****1888, Synthetic Bank C) in 4 transactions. Debits equal to 82% of credits were executed with a median of 14.4 hours between the latest credit and each debit. Screening on 30 May 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse‑media lists. The account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
